transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess what brings me in is something that happened at work. I got pretty worked up during a staff meeting, and... I just started acting out a whole fall-prevention drill right there in the room. I was moving the chairs around, waving my arms all over the place, and I just couldn't seem to stop doing it, even when folks were telling me to sit down. So, that's why I'm here.
How has your sleep been over the past several days?

Well, my sleep has been pretty short lately. I guess I only sleep about two or three hours a night. I'll wake up way before dawn and... I just feel completely ready to go. I don't feel tired at all. I'll just be up, making plans and figuring things out while the rest of the house is still pitch dark. I really didn't think anything was wrong with being up like that, to be honest, but yeah, that's how it's been.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt deeply depressed or down for weeks at a time?

No, not really. I mean... I've never felt down for weeks at a time like that. I get upset or have a bad day sometimes, just like anybody else, but... no, I wouldn't say I've ever been deeply depressed.
Have you ever had another time in your life when you felt unusually energized, wired, or full of ideas like this?

Yeah, I have. On those high-energy days, I just get a whole lot done. I'll clean out the closets, rewrite my care checklists for work... I even start planning a health fair for the church. I just get so full of ideas that I'll start calling people before breakfast, feeling like it all has to happen right then and there.
Have you heard any voices, or seen things that other people couldn't see or hear?

Well, yeah, sometimes I do. Like... if I'm alone in the hallway at work, or even just at home by the laundry room, I'll hear my name being called. Or I'll hear one of the residents calling out for help, clear as day. I always go to look, but... when I check, there just isn't anybody there.
When you had those times of high energy in the past, how long would that feeling usually last?

Well, it's... it's been going on for a while now. Those stretches where I'm just way too energized, sleeping barely at all, and trying to push all these big plans... they've been coming and going for about 11 months or so. It'll last a few weeks at a time, then back off, and then start up again.

latest_inference.note: Ruled out F30.2 as the patient reports recurrent manic episodes over the past 11 months, which under ICD-10 criteria classifies the condition as bipolar affective disorder, current episode manic with psychotic symptoms (F31.2).
